description: Modular oversight entity definitions referenced by oversight_entities in the unified pipeline registry. Each entity represents an accountability body that can receive complaints, conduct investigations, or impose sanctions.

entities.label: State Bar Association
entities.description: Regulates attorney conduct. Receives complaints about attorney misconduct, conflicts of interest, or ethical violations.
entities.complaint_pathway: File a grievance with the state bar's disciplinary board. Include attorney name, bar number, and specific conduct at issue.

entities.label: Judicial Conduct Commission
entities.description: Investigates complaints about judicial misconduct, bias, or procedural violations by judges.
entities.complaint_pathway: File a written complaint with the state judicial conduct commission. Include case number, judge name, and specific conduct.
entities.website_pattern: Varies by state — search '[state] judicial conduct commission'

entities.label: State Domestic Violence Coalition
entities.description: Statewide coalition coordinating DV services, policy advocacy, and system accountability.
entities.complaint_pathway: Contact the state coalition for advocacy support, system navigation, and policy complaints.

entities.label: Victim Advocate Office
entities.description: Provides victim advocacy services within the criminal justice system. Assists with safety planning, court accompaniment, and rights enforcement.
entities.complaint_pathway: Contact the local victim advocate office through the district attorney's office or local court.

entities.label: State Attorney General
entities.description: Chief legal officer of the state. Handles consumer protection, civil rights enforcement, and public interest litigation.
entities.complaint_pathway: File a consumer complaint or civil rights complaint through the AG's website. Include documentation of the violation.

entities.label: Local Housing Authority
entities.description: Administers public housing and Section 8 vouchers. Enforces housing quality standards.
entities.complaint_pathway: File a complaint about housing conditions or landlord violations with the local housing authority.

entities.label: HUD Regional Office
entities.description: Enforces Fair Housing Act. Investigates housing discrimination and landlord violations of federal housing standards.
entities.complaint_pathway: File a Fair Housing complaint at hud.gov or call 1-800-669-9777.

entities.label: Tenant Rights Organization
entities.description: Local tenant advocacy groups providing legal assistance, organizing support, and policy advocacy.
entities.complaint_pathway: Contact local tenant rights organization for assistance with landlord disputes.

entities.label: State Insurance Commissioner
entities.description: Regulates insurance companies operating in the state. Investigates unfair claim practices and policy violations.
entities.complaint_pathway: File a complaint through the state department of insurance website. Include policy number, denial letter, and timeline.

entities.label: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services
entities.description: Administers Medicare, Medicaid, and ACA marketplace. Enforces federal healthcare coverage standards.
entities.complaint_pathway: File a complaint at medicare.gov or call 1-800-MEDICARE for Medicare issues. For Medicaid, contact the state Medicaid office.

entities.label: National Association of Insurance Commissioners
entities.description: Coordinates insurance regulation across states. Maintains consumer complaint database and model regulations.
entities.complaint_pathway: Use NAIC's Consumer Information Source to research insurer complaint history.

entities.label: US Department of Labor
entities.description: Enforces FLSA, OSHA, and other federal labor laws. Investigates wage theft, overtime violations, and workplace safety.
entities.complaint_pathway: File a complaint with the Wage and Hour Division at dol.gov or call 1-866-4-USWAGE.

entities.label: State Labor Agency
entities.description: Enforces state wage and hour laws, which often provide stronger protections than federal law.
entities.complaint_pathway: File a wage claim with the state labor department. Include pay stubs, timesheets, and employment records.

entities.label: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission
entities.description: Enforces federal employment discrimination laws. Investigates workplace discrimination and harassment.
entities.complaint_pathway: File a charge of discrimination at eeoc.gov or visit a local EEOC office.

entities.label: State Child Welfare Oversight Body
entities.description: Oversees state child welfare agencies. Investigates systemic failures in child protection.
entities.complaint_pathway: File a complaint with the state child welfare oversight body or ombudsman.

entities.label: Administration for Children and Families — Children's Bureau
entities.description: Federal oversight of state child welfare systems. Monitors Title IV-E compliance and child welfare outcomes.
entities.complaint_pathway: Report systemic child welfare concerns to the Children's Bureau regional office.

entities.label: Court Appointed Special Advocates (CASA)
entities.description: Trained volunteers appointed by judges to advocate for children in foster care and dependency proceedings.
entities.complaint_pathway: Contact local CASA program for child advocacy support in dependency cases.

entities.label: Child Welfare Ombudsman
entities.description: Independent office investigating complaints about child welfare agency actions and decisions.
entities.complaint_pathway: File a complaint with the state child welfare ombudsman.

entities.label: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau
entities.description: Enforces federal consumer financial laws including FDCPA, FCRA, and TILA. Maintains public complaint database.
entities.complaint_pathway: File a complaint at consumerfinance.gov/complaint. Include collector name, account details, and specific violations.

entities.label: Federal Trade Commission
entities.description: Enforces consumer protection laws. Investigates deceptive business practices and unfair debt collection.
entities.complaint_pathway: Report fraud or unfair practices at reportfraud.ftc.gov.

entities.label: State Banking Regulator
entities.description: Regulates state-chartered banks and financial institutions. Investigates consumer complaints about financial services.
entities.complaint_pathway: File a complaint with the state banking department or division of financial institutions.

entities.label: Probate Court
entities.description: Court with jurisdiction over guardianship and conservatorship cases. Reviews guardian accountings and complaints.
entities.complaint_pathway: File a motion or petition with the probate court requesting review of guardian conduct.

entities.label: State Guardianship Oversight Program
entities.description: State program monitoring professional guardians and investigating complaints about guardian conduct.
entities.complaint_pathway: File a complaint with the state guardianship oversight program or office of public guardian.

entities.label: Adult Protective Services
entities.description: Investigates reports of abuse, neglect, and exploitation of vulnerable adults and elders.
entities.complaint_pathway: Call the state APS hotline to report suspected abuse or neglect. Reports can be anonymous.

entities.label: Long-Term Care Ombudsman
entities.description: Advocates for residents of nursing homes, assisted living, and other long-term care facilities.
entities.complaint_pathway: Contact the state or local LTC ombudsman program to report facility concerns.

entities.label: State Health Department
entities.description: Licenses and inspects healthcare facilities. Investigates complaints about facility conditions and care quality.
entities.complaint_pathway: File a complaint about a healthcare facility with the state health department's licensing division.

entities.label: DHS Office of Inspector General
entities.description: Independent oversight of DHS agencies including ICE, CBP, and USCIS. Investigates misconduct and civil rights violations.
entities.complaint_pathway: File a complaint at oig.dhs.gov or call the OIG hotline at 1-800-323-8603.

entities.label: DHS Office for Civil Rights and Civil Liberties
entities.description: Reviews and assesses DHS policies and activities for civil rights and civil liberties impacts.
entities.complaint_pathway: File a civil rights complaint at dhs.gov/crcl or email crcl@hq.dhs.gov.

entities.label: ACLU Immigrants' Rights Project
entities.description: Litigates cases involving immigrant rights, detention conditions, and family separation policies.
entities.complaint_pathway: Contact ACLU for potential impact litigation or legal assistance in immigration rights cases.

entities.label: Congressional Oversight (Immigration)
entities.description: Congressional committees with jurisdiction over immigration policy and DHS oversight.
entities.complaint_pathway: Contact your congressional representative to request a congressional inquiry into an immigration case.

entities.label: State Mental Health Authority
entities.description: Oversees state-funded mental health services, licensing of psychiatric facilities, and enforcement of mental health codes. Receives complaints about facility conditions, treatment quality, and patient rights violations.
entities.complaint_pathway: File complaint with your state's Department of Mental Health or equivalent agency. Include facility name, dates, and specific concerns. Many states have online complaint portals.

entities.label: Disability Rights / Protection & Advocacy Organization
entities.description: Federally mandated organization in every state with legal authority to investigate abuse and neglect in psychiatric facilities. Has unrestricted access to facilities and records. Can file lawsuits on behalf of individuals.
entities.complaint_pathway: Contact your state's Protection & Advocacy organization (P&A). They have legal authority to enter any facility, access records, and investigate complaints. This is often the most powerful oversight tool available.

entities.label: The Joint Commission
entities.description: Accredits hospitals and behavioral health facilities. Complaints about patient safety, quality of care, or rights violations can trigger unannounced surveys. Loss of accreditation threatens facility funding.
entities.complaint_pathway: File a quality of care complaint at jointcommission.org. Include facility name, dates, and description of the concern. The Joint Commission investigates complaints and can conduct unannounced surveys.

entities.label: Patient Advocate / Ombudsman
entities.description: Internal or state-appointed advocate for patients in psychiatric facilities. Investigates complaints, mediates disputes, and ensures patient rights are respected. Some states mandate patient advocates in all psychiatric facilities.
entities.complaint_pathway: Request to speak with the patient advocate or ombudsman at the facility. If the facility does not have one, contact the state mental health authority to request advocacy services.

entities.label: HHS Office for Civil Rights (OCR)
entities.description: Enforces HIPAA privacy and access rights, ADA protections, and civil rights in healthcare settings. Investigates complaints about records access denial, privacy violations, and discrimination.
entities.complaint_pathway: File a complaint at hhs.gov/ocr. Complaints must be filed within 180 days of the violation. OCR can investigate, impose corrective action, and levy civil monetary penalties.

entities.label: State Board of Pharmacy
entities.description: Licenses and regulates pharmacies and pharmacists; investigates medication dispensing complaints.
entities.complaint_pathway: File complaint with state board of pharmacy via online form or written complaint

entities.label: State Medical Board / Board of Medical Examiners
entities.description: Licenses and disciplines physicians; investigates complaints about prescribing practices and standard of care.
entities.complaint_pathway: File complaint with state medical board via online form or written complaint

entities.label: FDA MedWatch — Adverse Event Reporting
entities.description: FDA's safety reporting program for adverse events related to medications, devices, and other products.
entities.complaint_pathway: Submit MedWatch Online Voluntary Reporting Form (FDA Form 3500)

entities.label: CMS State Survey Agency
entities.description: Conducts surveys and inspections of healthcare facilities on behalf of CMS; investigates complaints about conditions of participation.
entities.complaint_pathway: File complaint with state health department survey and certification division
